primary.title: How to check NPS balance 2026
primary.summary: Your NPS balance won’t magically grow faster if you check it every day—but ignoring it completely isn’t a strategy either. Here’s how to keep tabs on your retirement corpus without turning it into a full-time job. The post How to check NPS balance 2026 appeared first on Blogs .
